name: EPUB Viewer
description: Open local EPUB files in a Chrome extension reader powered by foliate-js.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: script-src 'self'; object-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' blob: data:; frame-src 'self' blob: data:; connect-src 'self' blob: data: file:;
